quote: The problem was posed by the 2016 paper 'Colourability and word-representability of near-triangulations' (arXiv:1605.01688), which characterised K4-free near-triangulations and left near-triangulations containing K4 as open
note: The problem originates from the 2016 arXiv preprint where Glen characterized word-representable K4-free near-triangulations. Near-triangulations containing K4 were explicitly left as an open problem because K4 is non-3-colorable, and the coloring-based approach used for the K4-free case does not apply.
